title: Chapter 358
text:
After experiencing the convenience of the automatic assembly, Han Xiao could not help but sigh. Magnetic Link is really good stuff.

The exoskeleton armor was rough and ferocious. The thick and black alloy armor and the intertwined mechanical structure were very visually appealing. The Assault Form leaned towards strength and defense, moving like a train. The mechanical limbs were thick and equipped with a large number of power structures, giving an additional ten points of strength and over ten thousand armor points.

Advantages and disadvantages always came together. The disadvantage of the Assault Form was that it lowered agility. Amphiptere's body was wrapped in the thick exoskeleton armor, but luckily, with the knowledge of Neural Link, it was very easy to control the exoskeleton mechanical limbs.

Battle Scythe — Electric Axe was originally a two-meter-long weapon, but now it was like a short scythe for harvesting crops. Han Xiao charged forward with large strides, causing the ground to shake. Slash after slash, the scythe and Battleship Slicing Blade clashed continuously. The two of them fought fiercely.

Clang clang clang! The Battleship Slicing Blade left scars on the armor. Han Xiao knew Advanced Materials Science and combined it with Advanced Electromagnetism to create a new alloy. The material was tough and had an additional damage reduction effect after electricity was applied. Combined with the tough materials from before, the defense was extremely high. If it was normal steel, it would have been cut in half by Herlous' blade.

Han Technician was not arrogant enough to fight a Pugilist in close combat. He could now control seven Sonic Spheres at the same time, so he could bear a higher load on his nerves. He also had various weapons attacking continuously.

After fighting for a while, the exoskeleton armor was full of scars, and Herlous was also cut a few times by the scythe. They were basically on par.

Clang!

After the last clash of weapons, the two of them pulled away and stopped attacking at the same time.

"Not bad." Han Xiao chuckled.

After this fight, he had a more direct understanding of his own combat ability. The threshold for Grade B was 5,000 Ona, and the standard for Grade A was 1 Ona. The calculation model of the Energy Rank was a curve. The higher the number, the bigger the difference. Therefore, the higher the Grade, the more obvious the difference between those of the same Grade. The destructive power of 5,000 Ona and 9,000 Ona was completely different.

Han Xiao's combat power was around 5,300, and he was still a Grade B newbie. Herlous had been Grade B for many years, but he had been neglecting his training, so his Energy Rank was only around 5,000. However, with Herlous' talent, he still had a lot of room for improvement.

Level B strength was the backbone of the starry sky and could basically protect themselves. However, it was still far from the level where they could do whatever they wanted. Knowing his own level, Han Xiao could better plan his next move.

Herlous let out a deep breath and put away his weapon. He would not use his trump card until the battle was over. He knew very well that as a Mechanic, Han Xiao would definitely have more trump cards. Just from the exchange of blows just now, he had already felt a great deal of pressure. Han Xiao's attacks were endless, just like a hedgehog. If he wasn't careful, he would be injured … Oh, no, he was already injured.

After bandaging the wounds on his body, with the physique of a Pugilist, it would probably heal in a few hours. Black Star was an opponent of the same level, and Han Xiao's combat power had gained his recognition.

Herlous was much more relieved about Han Xiao's safety. When he first joined the Black Star Mercenary, he realized that he was the strongest in the team and always felt that he was unreliable. Now that he finally had someone of the same level, Herlous' view changed. To be more specific … he originally thought that his teammate was a burden, but now he was gradually becoming a reliable partner.

Furthermore, with someone of the same level, it meant that they had a common topic to talk about. The two of them smiled at each other and felt a sense of trust. Only people of the same level would have the foundation to trust each other.

Herlous took the initiative to help move a few equipment boxes. The two of them walked out of the simulation room together and saw Mad Blade and a few other players waiting at the door. They were all shocked.

"Black Phantom, you're so strong!" Mad Blade's eyes were twinkling with stars. The content of his words was like a piece of cake.

Mad Blade was very diligent. He wanted to find Herlous to trigger a guidance event, but he coincidentally saw the battle just now and was shocked. Because the mercenary group's information was public, Herlous was the only Grade B, but Han Xiao was evenly matched with Herlous just now, so he was definitely a Grade B too! Mad Blade and the others immediately came up with a logical explanation. Han Xiao must have been hiding his strength during the test.

In the traditional view, the leader should be the strongest. The original leader's strength was not as strong as the new leader's, and this made the players feel uncomfortable. Only now did Mad Blade and the others feel comfortable. Han Technician's image was strong and mysterious. In the eyes of the players, he should be someone who could capture the moon from the top of the world and hunt turtles from the bottom of the world. Only the current performance matched the position of Han Xiao in their hearts.

Mad Blade was one of the earliest players to follow Han Xiao and witnessed the rise of Han Xiao step by step. Every time he saw Han Xiao, he was habitually glad that he had made the choice back then. However, ever since he entered the galaxy, Mad Blade had been a little depressed. Because the team had expanded and the number of people had increased, he felt that he was left out.

Back then, when Han Xiao had issued those quests with high rewards, Mad Blade had never gotten tired of them. However, the quests now were too serious, and Mad Blade missed that feeling very much.

However, at the same time, he was secretly happy because of that. One had to know that no other players had seen those quests before. Even Hao, Maple Moon, and Pork Bun, the other three core members, did not know what Han Xiao was like in the past. Only he had tried it. It was a very interesting experience, and he often recalled it.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and quietly moved a step to the side. He felt that the way Mad Blade looked at him was a little weird.

"Who's Black Phantom?" Herlous did not react in time.

Han Xiao waved his hand. "Don't mind it. That's my nickname on my mother planet."

"Oh, I forgot. You're a famous person on your mother planet." Herlous secretly made up his mind to find out more about Han Xiao's past from his teammates. He was very interested.

There was not much activity during the voyage. Other than sparring with Herlous occasionally, Han Xiao would chat with Gashley when he was free to learn about the history of the ring. Sometimes, they would talk about their experiences traveling the universe.

Gashley was a veteran mercenary, and he had been to many places. When it came to bragging, he would often start with the phrase 'back in the day'. In terms of talking, the Great Mechanic Han was never weak. In terms of knowledge, even ten Gashley's combined could not compare to him. The two of them chatted happily and gradually became familiar with each other.

Most of the regular mercenaries were more straightforward and liked to make friends.

The players often communicated with the other ring mercenaries. When they talked about the standard armor of both parties, the ring mercenaries showed the effect of the ring armor. It was actually a product of compression technology. Pressing the triangular crystal on the chest, the simple and crude ring combat suit would fold and expand, turning into different complete forms. It was very beautiful.

The Sunil soldier armor was instantly overshadowed, and the players were all shocked and envious.

Seeing that the players were tempted by their resources, the ring mercenaries tried to lure the players in privately, promising that they would be able to get a set of ring armor for free if they joined the ring. As long as the recommendation was successful, the person who recommended it would also be rewarded. Headhunting was a common activity in the mercenary industry. The atmosphere was very free. Many of the ring mercenaries originally belonged to other mercenary groups but were headhunted by the better treatment.

However, the players did not fall for this at all. Being tempted did not mean being swayed. They were still waiting for more good things to appear in the mercenary group store. Perhaps one day, the Black Star store would also have ring armor, so they were not in a hurry at all. These players trusted Han Xiao very much.

The private invitations were all rejected, and the ring mercenaries were very surprised. They did not expect the mercenaries under Black Star to be so loyal.

Han Xiao learned about this from Pork Bun and was in a good mood. The cohesion of the faction was slowly forming, and this group of players had the style of a backbone.

…

At the same time, in a certain asteroid belt in the Fawn Star System.

A few scavenger spaceships moved stealthily, maintaining the Information Interference Force Field and [Stealth] state. It was the scavenger organization that attacked the Silvers. This was a group of slave traders who often sold human beings. They were notorious and had been rampant in the Shattered Star Ring for a long time.

At the bottom of one of the spaceships was a prison dedicated to holding captives. This group of scavenger had done this several times before attacking the Silvers. The 'goods' that were not too valuable were locked together, and the expensive slaves were locked up separately. The seventeen captured Silvers were locked up separately.

A thin man with light golden skin and messy white hair walked into the prison area. He looked gloomy. He was the leader of this group of scavenger. His name was Peggy, and he was a mixed-blood Godora. He only had one-eighth of the Godora bloodline in his body, but his appearance was still very similar to that of a Godora. This showed the dominance of Godora genes. The difference was that there were thin scales on his skin, and his eyes were vertical like the eyes of a snake. He also had some kind of Snake genes.

As soon as they saw him, the prisoners in the large prison cell became agitated and shouted.

"Let me out!"

"I'm an exploration team member of the Holy Stone Civilization. How dare you capture me? Let me go immediately, or I will …"

"Who are you going to sell us to?"
